item.description: The National Invitational Tournament is coming to Illinois State University, giving basketball teams that did not make the NCAA Tournament a chance to compete in the postseason at a high level.

item.title: Six wounded in shooting on Franklin Avenue - WZND Fuzed Radio
item.description: NORMAL, Ill. - Normal Police are investigating a shooting that injured six people early this morning. Officers responded around 2:40 a.m. to reports of multiple shots fired in the 700 block of Franklin Avenue in Normal.
